mode: Read-only inventory and handoff; no files deleted
rootMustCombineWith: Current west repair/selection pipeline; v4 already includes internal tone-v2 plus geometry-v3 and new v4 corrections. Do not replay old flow.
permanentTextProvenance: Retain per-image model/quality/source evidence, all prompt and reference hashes, processing/review/selection records. Historical image paths can be marked deliberately removed after final selection; do not falsify their source hashes.
geometryAndToneReproducibility: Keep saved v2, v3, v4 displacement fields and tone fields if selected processing provenance requires them; these are processing data rather than picture backups.
deletionPreconditions: Root final selected game PNG exists and dimensions/hash are verified
Current import/export/runtime dependencies point to the selected final artifact
Active root scripts no longer require candidate or intermediate PNG input
Preserve needed design and source record files; no deletion of original assets outside task
